versions.changelog:
- Version 0.1.1 released with no file or documentation changes detected.
- No new features, fixes, or updates included in this release.

- Initial release of the drawing-parser engine.
- Supports parsing DWG, DXF, PDF, and image (PNG/JPG) architectural drawings.
- Extracts structured data: texts, paragraphs, tables, and dimensions.
- Offers four OCR modes with automatic fallback for PDF/image parsing.
- Provides both Python API and command-line usage.
- Outputs results to structured JSON for downstream use.
